class: Resolved text answer leaks into later substring-related questions
symptom: Panasonic application 569 candidate profile received the street address in both Address and Address 2 before the resume was uploaded.
site: Panasonic Automotive iCIMS candidate profile, 26 October 2026
root_cause: _answer_text_questions appended a resolved question as an unanchored regex to the shared answers list, so subsequent questions containing that label reused its value.
why_tests_missed: Tests covered individual question recognition but not multiple related labels in one text-answer pass.
fix: Keep dynamically resolved answers local to the current question; retain the common base rules without accumulating question-specific values.
prevention: Test question sequences in both orders, including Address/Address 2 and Employer/Previous Employer; resolved values must not become generic rules.
